document.abstract: The Committee is endeavoring to augment the motion picture exhibit at the National Museum of the Smithsonian Institution at Washington, which the Board of Governors has chosen as the official museum for historical exhibits collected by the Society. A complete list of motion picture exhibits at the Museum is given, and a plea is made for assistance by the members of the Society in adding to the accessions.
